From: Derek Mills <derek.mills@forge-sys.com>

Date: 2027-02-02T14:10:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Security intake & encryption plan for Forge Systems pilot

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — this was helpful. A few quick follow-ups from our security and procurement teams so we can scope a pilot: 

1) Is Redwood SOC 2 Type II certified today? If so, can you share the latest report or a one-pager that summarizes scope (hosted API vs private deployments)?
2) Encryption strategy: what do you provide by default for data in transit and at rest?
3) Do you support customer-managed keys (BYOK)? If so, which KMS/HSM providers are supported (AWS KMS, AWS CloudHSM, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault)?
4) For hosted offerings, is there a separation that ensures our keys/CMKs are used only for our tenant (i.e., no key multi-tenancy)?
5) Audit logs and key rotation policies — what do you surface to customers?
6) Any HIPAA/GDPR notes we should be aware of for handling PHI/PII in inference requests?

Procurement is also asking whether there will be any incremental cost to enable CMK support and roughly how long it takes to get this enabled (we're aiming to run a two-week pilot in March).

Could you put together a short answer set and any artifacts you can share? If easier, we can schedule a kickoff with your security lead.

Regards,
Derek
Derek Mills
Sr. Director, IT Security
Forge Systems

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Derek Mills <derek.mills@forge-sys.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-03T09:18:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Security intake & encryption plan for Forge Systems pilot

Hi Derek — great to connect. Below is a concise post-call recap addressing your questions plus next steps. Attaching a short security one-pager and our KMS matrix to make the details easier to scan.

Short answers (high level):
- SOC 2: Redwood holds SOC 2 Type II (Security) for our hosted control plane and inference service. We have a scoped report for hosted API; private/on-prem packages are covered via an enterprise-specific attestation — see attached SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf and Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf for scope notes.
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ (Mutual TLS available for Dedicated/Private deployments). All API traffic is encrypted end-to-end.
- At rest: AES-256 envelope encryption by default for model state and artifacts in hosted.
- Customer-managed keys (CMK/BYOK): Supported. For hosted API we support AWS KMS CMKs using envelope encryption; for Dedicated/Private we can integrate with AWS CloudHSM, GCP KMS, and Azure Key Vault or on-prem HSMs. See KMS_integration_matrix.xlsx for details on each flow.
- Key isolation: When you enable a CMK for your tenant on the hosted plan, the CMK is associated exclusively with your encryption envelope keys — we do not use a shared CMK for encrypting customer data.
- Audit logs / rotation: We provide key usage logs surfaced in the Console and a downloadable audit trail (token-level request logs, key usage events). Key rotation is customer-driven for CMKs; we provide guidance and an automated re-wrap tool for objects encrypted with rotated keys.
- HIPAA/GDPR: We support HIPAA-covered workflows; we recommend Private deployment for PHI due to customer control of the key lifecycle and network isolation. GDPR: we provide data residency controls and can sign SCCs / DPA language as needed.

Attachments included in this reply: Redwood_Security_OnePager.pdf (summary), KMS_integration_matrix.xlsx (integration matrix), Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx (template you can fill if helpful).

Proposed next steps / timeline (we recommend):
1) Security kickoff call (30–45m) with our security engineer (Stephanie) + solutions lead (Lauren) to walk the intake and any questionnaire you want completed.
2) Customer fills basic intake + questionnaire (we can pre-populate the parts we own).
3) DPA/Docusign — procurement signs DPA (we'll send a link).
4) CMK enablement: for hosted API with AWS KMS, 2–3 weeks after DPA + key provisioning. For Dedicated/Private options, integration can be completed in parallel with provisioning and is typically 1–2 weeks depending on HSM onboarding.

No mandatory surcharge for CMK support on our standard Dedicated plan; for hosted API there can be a small integration and HSM usage fee if you require CloudHSM-backed key material — we can quantify after we know the exact flow you prefer.

Would Wednesday (Feb 9) or Thursday (Feb 10) work for a kickoff? I’ve cc’d Lauren (solutions lead) and Stephanie (security).

Thanks — happy to jump on a call and walk through the matrix.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

Thanks Aditya — this is very helpful. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/security after reading the one-pager:

- Can you confirm whether the SOC 2 report you attached includes the hosted inference runtime (model serving) and telemetry/log exports? We need to know the exact control boundary.
- For CMK on hosted: when you say "key provisioning" — do we create CMKs in our own AWS account and grant Redwood a Grant or do you host a CMK in your account that you rotate per customer? We prefer the former.
- Key rotation and emergency key revocation: does Redwood have a documented process? If we revoke a CMK, what happens to in-flight requests and stored artifacts encrypted under that key?
- Are audit logs available in our own account (e.g., CloudTrail events) or only exported via Redwood Console?

Also — procurement asked for a rough cost delta for CloudHSM-backed keys (ballpark).

We'll take either Feb 9 or 10 for the kickoff; Feb 10 afternoon (after 2pm ET) is best for our team.

Regards,
Derek

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Security intake & encryption plan for Forge Systems pilot

Derek — thanks, answers inline below and next steps to get the pilot moving.

1) SOC 2 scope: the attached SOC2-Report-Redwood-2026.pdf covers our hosted control plane and inference runtime (model serving), telemetry collection, and the logging export pipeline. We’ve annotated the report for you with control boundaries in the Security One-Pager (see section "Scope and Boundaries"). If you want, Stephanie can walk through the control mappings on the kickoff.

2) CMK model for hosted: we support customer-owned CMKs in your AWS account. Typical flow: you create a CMK in your AWS account, create a Grant for Redwood's service principal, and we use envelope encryption so the CMK never leaves your account. We do not require you to create keys in our account. For CloudHSM-backed material, we support both customer-managed HSM clusters and sessions via CloudHSM in your account for enterprise contracts.

3) Rotation & revocation: we have a documented Key Management Playbook. High-level: rotation is customer-driven for CMKs — you can rotate and create new key versions; our rewrap tool will re-encrypt stored objects on your schedule (can be run online or as a scheduled job). For emergency revocation, if a CMK becomes unusable/revoked, any objects encrypted with that CMK will be inaccessible until you restore a key or provide a new key that can unwrap the envelope key. In-flight requests are rejected if the unwrap step fails; we log the event and surface it immediately. We’ll share the playbook during the kickoff.

4) Audit logs: when you use customer-owned CMKs in your AWS account, CloudTrail records key usage (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, etc.) in your account. We also surface request-level logs in the Redwood Console and can export an encrypted stream to a customer-owned logging bucket if you prefer.

5) Cost delta (CloudHSM): ballpark — CloudHSM usage typically adds a fixed monthly HSM cost plus per-hour/session charges depending on your region and throughput. For a pilot-sized workload (single HSM cluster to support a small Dedicated pool) expect mid-four-figure monthly HSM fees; we’ll provide a precise quote once we know the expected throughput/requests-per-second.

Next steps (agreed):
- Kickoff with Stephanie + Lauren: Feb 10 at 3:30pm ET (we’ll send calendar invite).
- Stephanie will run through scope, share the Key Management Playbook, and walk the questionnaire template.
- I’ll assign a HubSpot deal record (RDW-2027-FORGE-01) and upload the attachments to the security folder.

If you can, please provision a CMK in your AWS account and share the KeyARN with us after the kickoff (we can provide the Grant creation steps). I’ll also send a Docusign link for the DPA after the kickoff.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
